about.body: Founded in Québec City, the Citadelle is more than a school: it's a martial arts family. We offer a safe yet demanding environment where every student progresses at their own pace, guided by certified black belt instructors.

Waiver.title: Liability Waiver
Waiver.subtitle: Please read carefully and complete this form before participating in classes.
Waiver.alreadySigned: You have already signed the liability waiver.

fields.photoConsentYes: I authorize the school to use photos or videos taken during activities for promotional purposes.
fields.signatureHint: By entering your name, you confirm that you have read and agreed to the entire document.

sections.risksText: I acknowledge that the practice of martial arts involves risks, including muscular, joint or bone injuries, strikes, shocks or falls, and the aggravation of pre-existing medical conditions. I understand that despite safety measures in place, it is impossible to entirely eliminate the risks associated with martial arts practice.
sections.healthText: I declare that I am in good physical condition and have no medical condition that prevents me from participating in activities. If applicable, I take responsibility for informing the school and providing a medical certificate as needed.
sections.liabilityText: By signing this document, I release Citadelle Jiu-Jitsu, its instructors, employees, volunteers and representatives from any liability for injuries, bodily harm, loss or death that may occur during my participation in classes, training sessions, demonstrations or competitions.
sections.liabilityNote: This release does not apply in cases of gross negligence or intentional misconduct on the part of the school or its representatives, in accordance with the laws in force in Québec.
sections.commitmentText: I commit to respecting the school's safety and hygiene rules, adopting a respectful attitude toward instructors and other students, and reporting any injury or discomfort during activities.
sections.minorText: As the parent/legal guardian of the child named above, I consent to their participation in the school's activities and accept the risks and release of liability described above.
